g.text: Every neighborhood gained e-bikes, yet city-wide e-bike share fell

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Share of trips on e-bikes, Jan-Jun to Jul-Dec: -1.7 points city-wide, +4.5 to +7.5 points by neighborhood. Harbor Flats (new, low e-bike use) took 31% of H2 trips.
